description: Golden parity cases for the lib/github-status routing and label reads and priority_for_labels (lib/workflow-board) in the .NET rewrite (#252): each case's shell function, its arguments (a JSON string is passed as its text, any other value as jq -c prints it), whether the tool answers it or refuses it (exit 3, so bash answers), the locale it was recorded in when the answer depends on it, and the status (0, 2 for pr_next_phase_for_board_status's no phase, 1 for any other failure) and output the function gives. test/oneshot-checks-parity.bats checks the shell side and regenerates status and output; Credfeto.Orchestrator.Predicates.Tests checks the tool.
